description: Find the best-matching PAGES for a query, ranked by how many of your query terms each page covers. Searches one wiki if `wiki` is given, otherwise every active wiki. Each result has its wiki, path, matched terms, and a short snippet for orientation — then read_document the page to get the answer. Returns a `confident` flag: if false, the wiki(s) likely lack this — fall back to web search.

wiki.description: Optional wiki slug to restrict the search. Omit to search all wikis.

name: search
title: Search wikis
